title: Efficiency, elapsed time included
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. The operator added that what is measured includes elapsed time, and that a task running far longer than its size suggests is stopped and reported.
decision: Every story and task reports its effort: agent runs by role, tokens and elapsed time, against the rough cost its story stated. One that runs far beyond its size is stopped and reported to the operator, never pushed on through more runs.
consequences: The efficiency and ledger concepts state this.
